title: Verify dragging Closure line invokes MinifracFunc command
steps: Open Minifrac Analysis for a well/treatment with a Closure line visible on the plot.
Drag the Closure line to a new X position and release.
Capture the outbound command/request issued for the drag.
expected_results: Minifrac plot loads with Closure line displayed.
Closure line moves to the new position.
MinifracFunc command is invoked as a result of the drag.
label: Critical

title: Verify MinifracFunc is not invoked until Closure drag completes to a new position
steps: Open Minifrac with Closure line displayed.
Begin dragging Closure but return it to the original position before release (or cancel if supported).
Observe whether MinifracFunc is invoked.
expected_results: Closure line is available for drag.
Drag gesture completes without a lasting new position (or cancel).
Behavior remains stable; no spurious MinifracFunc for a non-change if product treats it as no-op (document actual).
label: Standard

title: Verify MinifracFunc payload y value is always -1 on Closure drag
steps: Open Minifrac with Closure line displayed.
Drag Closure to a new position.
Inspect the MinifracFunc command payload y field.
expected_results: Drag completes and MinifracFunc is sent.
label: Standard

title: Verify MinifracFunc payload y remains -1 across multiple Closure drag positions
steps: Open Minifrac with Closure line displayed.
Drag Closure to at least three different X positions in sequence.
Inspect y on each MinifracFunc invocation.
label: Standard

title: Verify MinifracFunc payload x reflects the new Closure line position
steps: Open Minifrac and note the Closure line starting X.
Drag Closure to a clearly different X position.
Compare MinifracFunc payload x to the new Closure position.
expected_results: Closure settles at the new position.
Payload x matches the new Closure line position (per product coordinate calculation).
label: Standard

title: Verify x for Closure drag uses same calculation logic as tangent-line right-click
steps: On a Minifrac/related plot where tangent right-click MinifracFunc (or equivalent) exists, right-click the tangent at a known plot location and capture computed x.
Drag Closure so its position maps to the same plot location used for that calculation.
Compare Closure-drag MinifracFunc x to the tangent right-click x for the same location.
expected_results: Closure drag MinifracFunc is invoked for the matching location.
x values are consistent between Closure drag and tangent right-click calculation logic.
label: Critical

title: Verify Closure-drag x calculation remains consistent when repeating the same target position
steps: Drag Closure to position A and capture MinifracFunc x.
Move Closure away, then drag back to the same position A.
Compare the second MinifracFunc x to the first.
expected_results: First x for position A is recorded.
Second x equals first x (deterministic calculation).
label: Standard

title: Verify MinifracFunc is invoked after drag ends (not only on mouse-down)
steps: Open Minifrac with Closure displayed.
Press on Closure to start drag without moving, then move to a new position and release.
Correlate MinifracFunc timing with drag start vs drag end.
expected_results: Closure moves and is released at new position.
MinifracFunc is associated with completing the move to the new position (per AC: when user drags to a new position).
label: Standard

title: Verify SignalR response after MinifracFunc triggers minifracParams GET
steps: Open Minifrac and drag Closure to a new position so MinifracFunc is invoked.
Wait for the corresponding SignalR response for that command.
Capture the next HTTP call related to Minifrac parameters.
expected_results: Application calls minifracParams GET API after the SignalR response.
label: Critical

title: Verify minifracParams GET is not called before SignalR response for the drag command
steps: Prepare network monitoring before dragging Closure.
Drag Closure to invoke MinifracFunc.
Observe request order: MinifracFunc → SignalR response → minifracParams GET.
expected_results: minifracParams GET occurs after the corresponding SignalR response, not before.
label: Standard

title: Verify minifracParams GET retrieves updated Minifrac parameters for current context
steps: Drag Closure and wait for SignalR success path.
Inspect minifracParams GET request (well/treatment/context identifiers).
Inspect response payload for updated Minifrac/Closure-related parameters.
expected_results: GET targets minifracParams for the active analysis context.
label: Standard

title: Verify Information Box refreshes after successful minifracParams GET
steps: Note Closure-related values shown in the Information Box before drag.
Drag Closure so MinifracFunc → SignalR → minifracParams GET succeeds.
Observe the Information Box contents.
expected_results: Pre-drag Information Box values are known.
Information Box refreshes with the latest Closure-related parameter values.
label: Critical

title: Verify Information Box updates without requiring a manual plot refresh
steps: Open Minifrac with Information Box visible; do not use an explicit plot Refresh control.
Drag Closure through the full update path (command → SignalR → GET).
Confirm Information Box shows updated values while the plot session remains open.
expected_results: No manual plot refresh is performed.
Information Box shows updated Closure-related parameters without user-initiated plot refresh.
label: Standard

title: Verify Information Box Closure-related fields change when Closure moves to a different pressure/time region
steps: Record Information Box Closure-related values at Closure position A.
Drag Closure to position B where analysis results are expected to differ.
Compare Information Box values after the update path completes.
expected_results: Displayed Closure-related parameters reflect the new selection (not stale A values).
label: Standard

title: Verify end-to-end Closure drag synchronizes plot position, command, API, and Information Box
steps: Drag Closure to a new position.
Confirm Closure visual position, MinifracFunc x/y, minifracParams success, and Information Box update.
Ensure all four remain aligned to the same Closure selection.
expected_results: Closure is at the new position.
Command and API path succeed for that position.
Information Box matches the updated parameters for that Closure selection.
label: Critical

title: Verify successive Closure drags each run a fresh MinifracFunc → SignalR → minifracParams → Information Box cycle
steps: Drag Closure to position A and wait for Information Box update.
Drag Closure to position B and wait for Information Box update.
Confirm a distinct update cycle occurred for B (new command/API/box values).
expected_results: B cycle uses new Closure position; Information Box shows B values.
label: Regression

title: Verify rapid successive Closure drags do not leave Information Box on an older position
steps: Rapidly drag Closure across several positions, ending at a final position F.
Allow in-flight SignalR/API calls to settle.
Compare Information Box and Closure line to position F.
expected_results: Information Box reflects parameters for F (not an intermediate stale drag).
label: Regression

title: Verify behavior when SignalR response for MinifracFunc fails or times out
steps: Simulate or encounter a failed/timed-out SignalR response after Closure drag MinifracFunc.
Observe whether minifracParams GET is called.
Observe Information Box and UI stability.
expected_results: minifracParams GET is not treated as success path when SignalR did not succeed (no false success refresh).
UI remains stable; user is not left with a silently corrupted Information Box (error handling per product).
label: Standard

title: Verify behavior when minifracParams GET returns an error after SignalR success
steps: Complete Closure drag so MinifracFunc and SignalR succeed.
Cause or observe minifracParams GET failure (4xx/5xx/network).
Check Information Box and error feedback.
expected_results: Information Box is not shown as successfully updated with new values; UI remains usable / shows failure appropriately.
label: Standard

title: Verify behavior when minifracParams GET returns empty or incomplete Closure parameters
steps: Complete drag path through SignalR.
Receive a successful HTTP response with empty/missing Closure-related fields (if reproducible).
Observe Information Box rendering.
expected_results: GET returns successfully at HTTP level.
UI handles missing fields without crash (blank/placeholder/unchanged per product rules).
label: Standard

title: Verify dragging Closure when SignalR is disconnected
steps: Disconnect or block SignalR while Minifrac plot is open with Closure visible.
Drag Closure to a new position.
Observe command attempt, retries/errors, and Information Box.
expected_results: Update path does not falsely refresh Information Box as success; UI remains stable.
label: Standard

title: Verify no MinifracFunc invocation when Closure line is not displayed
steps: Open Minifrac/plot context without a Closure line (or before Closure is defined).
Attempt drag interactions on the plot area.
Confirm MinifracFunc is not fired for Closure-drag semantics.
expected_results: Plot remains interactive as otherwise allowed.
label: Standard

title: Verify Closure drag still works after leaving and returning to Minifrac
steps: Open Minifrac, confirm Closure drag update path works once.
Navigate away and return to Minifrac for the same well/treatment.
Drag Closure again and confirm MinifracFunc → SignalR → GET → Information Box.
expected_results: Second session drag again updates parameters and Information Box.
label: Regression

title: Verify Closure line visual position updates during/after drag independently of Information Box timing
steps: Drag Closure to a new X.
Observe Closure line position immediately after release.
Observe Information Box before and after API completion.
expected_results: Closure line shows the new position on the plot.
Information Box updates when params arrive; plot Closure position is not stuck at old X.
label: Regression

title: Verify dragging Closure near plot min X edge still sends valid MinifracFunc x and y=-1
steps: Drag Closure near the minimum visible/allowed X of the plot.
Capture MinifracFunc payload.
Confirm update path continues if command is accepted.
expected_results: Closure can be placed near min edge (or clamped per UI).
Payload has valid x for that position and y = -1.
label: Standard

title: Verify Closure dragged to plot rightmost allowed X still triggers full parameter refresh path
steps: Move Closure from a mid-plot position to the rightmost allowed X on the plot.
Confirm MinifracFunc fires, then wait for SignalR and minifracParams GET.
Confirm Information Box refreshes for that right-edge Closure selection.
expected_results: Closure settles at the rightmost allowed position (or UI clamp).
Full command → SignalR → GET sequence runs for that position.
Information Box shows updated Closure-related parameters for the right-edge selection.
label: Standard

title: Verify Closure drag does not require plot reload to re-enable subsequent drags
steps: Drag Closure once through a successful update.
Without refreshing the page/plot, drag Closure again.
Confirm second MinifracFunc is invoked.
expected_results: Second MinifracFunc fires for the new position.
label: Regression

title: Verify Information Box does not require page navigation to show updated Closure parameters
steps: Keep Minifrac and Information Box open.
Drag Closure and complete successful minifracParams GET.
Confirm updated values appear in-place in the Information Box.
expected_results: Updated Closure-related parameters display without navigating away.
label: Regression

title: Verify only Closure drag uses this update path — unrelated plot clicks do not call MinifracFunc with y=-1
steps: Open Minifrac with Closure displayed.
Click/pan elsewhere on the plot without dragging Closure.
Confirm MinifracFunc Closure-drag payload (x new, y=-1) is not wrongly issued.
expected_results: Closure-drag MinifracFunc path is not falsely triggered.
label: Regression

title: Verify MinifracFunc command name/identifier is MinifracFunc (not a different analysis Func)
steps: Drag Closure to a new position.
Inspect the command name/type on the outbound request.
Compare against other analysis commands (e.g. step-down) if visible in traffic.
expected_results: It is distinct from unrelated plot commands.
label: Standard

title: Verify API: minifracParams is invoked via GET method
steps: Complete Closure drag through SignalR success.
Inspect the minifracParams HTTP method.
Confirm it is GET.
expected_results: HTTP call to minifracParams is observed.
label: Standard

title: Verify API: minifracParams GET uses the active well/treatment context after Closure drag
steps: Open Minifrac for a known well/treatment.
Drag Closure and capture minifracParams request URL/body/query.
Confirm identifiers match the open well/treatment/analysis context.
expected_results: Request is scoped to that well/treatment/analysis context.
label: Standard

title: Verify UI: Closure line remains selectable/draggable after Information Box update
steps: Drag Closure and wait for Information Box refresh.
Attempt another Closure drag.
Confirm the line remains interactive.
expected_results: Closure control is not disabled after refresh.
label: Regression

title: Verify UI: Information Box layout remains usable when values update after drag
steps: Open Information Box with Closure-related parameters visible.
Drag Closure so values change.
Inspect layout overflow/clipping/readability of updated fields.
expected_results: Box remains readable and usable (no broken layout/crash).
label: Standard

title: Verify UI: dragging Closure shows immediate line movement feedback
steps: Press and drag the Closure line slowly across the plot.
Observe the line while the pointer moves.
Release at the new position.
expected_results: Line remains at the released position.
label: Regression

title: Verify validation: MinifracFunc x is numeric/finite for a normal Closure drag
steps: Drag Closure to a normal mid-plot position.
Inspect MinifracFunc payload x.
Confirm x is a valid numeric value (not NaN/null/undefined).
expected_results: x is a finite number consistent with plot coordinates.
label: Standard

title: Verify validation: y is exactly -1 (not 0, 1, or omitted) on Closure drag
steps: Drag Closure to a new position.
Inspect MinifracFunc payload for y.
Confirm exact value and presence.
label: Standard

title: Verify regression: Entry Friction analysis still opens and functions after Minifrac Closure-drag work
steps: From analysis area, open Entry Friction for a well.
Confirm Entry Friction loads core UI/data as before.
Return to Minifrac and confirm Closure drag path still works.
expected_results: No new regression blocking Entry Friction.
Minifrac Closure update path still works.
label: Regression

title: Verify regression: existing plot command flows (e.g. step-down callCommand) still work
steps: Open a plots workflow that uses existing callCommand / step-down commands (if available on the build).
Execute a previously working command action.
Confirm it still succeeds independently of Minifrac Closure drag.
expected_results: No regression from Minifrac Closure-drag changes.
label: Regression

title: Verify regression: SignalR connection used by the app still starts for non-Minifrac features
steps: Load Live+ so SignalR starts (app bootstrap).
Exercise a non-Minifrac SignalR-dependent notification/alert if available.
Open Minifrac and perform one Closure drag update.
expected_results: Minifrac Closure path can still use SignalR for its response.
label: Regression

title: Verify regression: navigating Analysis miniFrac route still reaches Minifrac screen
steps: Navigate to Analysis miniFrac route (`miniFrac` child route).
Confirm Minifrac Analysis view loads.
Confirm Closure (when implemented) is available for drag testing.
expected_results: Screen is ready for Closure interactions when feature is implemented.
label: Regression

title: Verify edge: dragging Closure by a very small delta still follows AC update path
steps: Drag Closure by a minimal visible amount to a slightly new position.
Check whether MinifracFunc fires with updated x and y=-1.
Confirm Information Box refresh path if command is accepted.
expected_results: Small move is recognized as new position (or documented threshold).
If treated as new position, MinifracFunc uses new x and y=-1.
label: Standard

title: Verify edge: switching wells/treatments then dragging Closure uses new context for minifracParams
steps: Complete a Closure drag update on well/treatment A.
Switch to well/treatment B Minifrac context.
Drag Closure on B and inspect minifracParams GET context.
expected_results: GET for B uses B identifiers (not stale A).
label: Regression

title: Verify edge: Information Box retains non-Closure fields while Closure-related fields update
steps: Note any non-Closure fields in the Information Box (if present).
Drag Closure and complete successful parameter refresh.
Compare Closure vs non-Closure fields.
expected_results: Closure-related fields update; unrelated fields are not incorrectly wiped unless API replaces full box content by design.
label: Regression

title: Verify negative: Closure drag while minifracParams is still in-flight from prior drag
steps: Drag Closure to A; before minifracParams returns, drag to B.
Allow requests to finish.
Confirm final Information Box aligns with final Closure position B.
expected_results: Overlapping requests occur or are queued.
Final UI state matches B (no stuck A values).
label: Standard

title: Verify current build gap — Minifrac Closure drag update path not implemented yet
steps: Open Analysis miniFrac in current Live_Plus_UAT build.
Inspect mini-frac-analysis UI for Closure line, MinifracFunc drag wiring, Information Box update.
Compare to US 116567 AC.
expected_results: Route may load stub content (`mini-frac-analysis works!`).
No implemented Closure-drag → MinifracFunc → SignalR → minifracParams → Information Box flow found yet.
Feature gap vs US 116567 is documented for implementation tracking.
label: Standard

title: Verify after implementation: first Closure drag updates Information Box without prior page refresh
steps: After implementation, open Minifrac with Closure and Information Box visible.
Drag Closure once to a new position.
Confirm full path without refreshing the browser page.
expected_results: Information Box shows updated Closure parameters without page refresh.
label: Standard

title: Verify after implementation: x calculation parity sample against tangent right-click at two locations
steps: After implementation, pick two distinct plot locations L1 and L2.
For each location, capture x from tangent right-click logic and from Closure drag to that location.
Compare pairs.
expected_results: L1 and L2 samples are collected.
Both interaction types produce x for each location.
For each location, Closure-drag x matches tangent right-click calculation logic.
label: Standard

title: Verify after implementation: y stays -1 while x changes across a drag sequence
steps: After implementation, drag Closure across a sequence of positions.
Collect MinifracFunc payloads.
Assert y and x properties across the sequence.
label: Standard

title: Verify after implementation: successful path displays updated Closure parameters in Information Box on final drag only once settled
steps: After implementation, drag Closure to a final position and wait for idle network.
Read Information Box Closure-related parameters once.
Confirm they match minifracParams response for that final position.
expected_results: Network is idle after final drag.
Displayed values match the successful minifracParams payload for the final Closure position.
label: Standard
